decisions.quote: We believed that our previous failure to replicate might have been a result of poorly documented data set / description of the dependent variable in the manuscript. Therefore, we decided to verify whether using some of the remaining measures disclosed in the data could lead to the desired results.
decisions.reason: This SCORE author-data reproduction report only examined computational reproducibility (attempting to recover the original reported ANOVA statistics and condition means from a poorly documented dataset lacking analysis scripts). In Analysis attempt 2-N, the analysts tried the 5 subscale variables solely to troubleshoot whether their inability to recover the reported numbers in Attempt 1 was due to misidentifying the dependent variable in the undocumented dataset, concluding in the Discussion that their failure to reproduce was likely due to being unable to identify the correct dependent variable. No robustness analysis of the original finding was conducted, so outcome_robustness is 'not checked'.
